description: This file defines Wi-Fi related constants, enums, and function prototypes for IEEE 802.11 protocol and Wi-Fi management within the Zephyr project. It includes security types, interface states, modes, link modes, scan types, power save modes, and TWT (Target Wake Time) configurations.

methods.name: wifi_security_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a given Wi-Fi security type.

methods.name: wifi_mfp_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a given MFP (Management Frame Protection) option.

methods.name: wifi_band_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a given Wi-Fi frequency band.

methods.name: wifi_state_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a given Wi-Fi interface state.

methods.name: wifi_mode_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a given Wi-Fi interface mode.

methods.name: wifi_link_mode_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a given Wi-Fi link mode.

methods.name: wifi_ps_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a Wi-Fi power save state.

methods.name: wifi_ps_mode_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a Wi-Fi power save mode.

methods.name: wifi_twt_operation_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a TWT operation.

methods.name: wifi_twt_negotiation_type_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a TWT negotiation type.

methods.name: wifi_twt_setup_cmd_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a TWT setup command.

methods.name: wifi_twt_get_err_code_str
methods.description: Returns a string description for a TWT error code.

methods.name: wifi_ps_wakeup_mode_txt
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a Wi-Fi power save wakeup mode.

methods.name: wifi_ps_get_config_err_code_str
methods.description: Returns a string description for a Wi-Fi power save configuration error code.
